title: Food dye color-gradient mock sitting drop plate on OT-2 vs manual
goal: Validate OT-2 reservoir mixing and sitting drop deposition in a 24-well CrysChem plate using red/blue/yellow dyes and compare with manual pipetting, including the reservoir surface flattening step.

title: Automated HEWL 24-well sitting drop crystallization
goal: Test whether the OT-2 can set up HEWL sitting drop crystallization (varied precipitant volume and acetate pH) that yields crystals in 24 h.

title: OT-2 vs human HEWL plate preparation comparison
goal: Compare time and crystal-growth consistency of HEWL plates set up by the OT-2 versus by three people of varying wet lab experience.
unresolved_refs: Manual plate setup and crystal scoring methods for human-prepared plates not described in methods

title: Pipetting accuracy of water and glycerol solutions, OT-2 vs human
goal: Assess accuracy and precision of small-volume water pipetting (1 and 100 µL) and viscous glycerol solutions (0-100%) with the OT-2 pipets versus a human.
unresolved_refs: Gravimetric/measurement method for pipetting accuracy not described in methods

title: Automated CJ (CJ0420 variant) 24-well sitting drop crystallization
goal: Demonstrate OT-2 setup of CJ protein sitting drop crystallization across pH 6.0/6.5 and ammonium sulfate 3.35-3.60 M.
unresolved_refs: CJ crystals grown 'according to previously optimized conditions [23]'
